info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Payments-v2-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Payments Retrieval API enables users to access and list utility billing payment records efficiently. This endpoint provides essential data related to customer payments, allowing businesses to track transactions and reconcile accounts. Ideal for financial analysts and accounting departments, this API facilitates reporting and monitoring of payment histories. Use cases include generating payment summaries, analyzing payment trends, and enhancing customer service experiences as stakeholders can retrieve detailed billing data quickly.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the payment details related to billing. It provides information such as payment status, amount, and transaction ID, aiding in comprehensive billing management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a payment request for billing purposes. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included in the request to facilitate the payment process.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsRequest.title: Payment Request Body
ListUtilityBillingPaymentsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to billing and payment. It is a string that contains payment-related information.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsResponse_200.title: Payment Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the payment operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the payment.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the payment operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment processing.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the payment in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the payment operation.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsResponse_200.description: The response schema for the successful payment operation GET request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the payment record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the payment record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the payment operation was initiated by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the payment operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the processing took for the request. This header can be utilized for performance analysis and monitoring.
